about: Index of this folder for the Tariff Order Intelligence Start page. One entry per PDF: state, licensees (first = the utility the order is registered under), commission, reading profile, order type. kind: order = can be read; supporting = listed for reference; hold = listed, not read until a decision is made. Written 2026-09-28 from the orders themselves; notes cite PDF page numbers (1-based index).

entries.title: NPCL Tariff Order FY 2026-27 (Petition 2330/2025)
notes: Same file (SHA-256 ff36813e...) as the order registered in the cloud setup.
Approved rate schedule: Annexure-I, PDF pages 352-400. Annexure-II (p.401) is average billing rates, not tariff.
In force seven days after newspaper publication (para 11.1.2, p.351).
Pages 402-417 and 419-423 are scanned stamps and signatures.

entries.title: State DISCOMs Tariff Order FY 2026-27 (PVVNL, MVVNL, PuVVNL, DVVNL, KESCO)
notes: One schedule shared by all five companies: Annexure-I, PDF pages 408-458.
Subsidised tables print four rows per rate; only 'Tariff Payable' is billed to consumers.
The order writes 'PuVVNL' in mixed case: rows may arrive without a company tag; set it in review.

KERC Combined Tariff Order 2025 for ESCOMs (BESCOM, MESCOM, CESC, HESCOM, GESCOM)
notes: Same file (SHA-256 d84997a4...) as the KERC order in the cloud setup's golden manifest.
Approves three tariff years (FY 2025-26, 2026-27, 2027-28); schedule is Annexure-9, PDF pages 538-570.
Tables 6.2 and 6.3 (PDF 226-240) are images: the app does not OCR them yet, so the approved summary will be reported missing.
Corrigendum of 26 May 2025 changes subsidy tables and DERS text, not the schedule (see the corrigendum below).

entries.title: APERC Retail Supply Tariff Order FY 2026-27 (APSPDCL, APCPDCL, APEPDCL)

Page 230 (HT Industry seasonal ToD rates) has no text layer: those values cannot be cross-read and must be checked by eye.
The file was edited after issue (created 25.03.2026, modified 21.04.2026 with PDFescape); pages 230 and 234 inside the schedule differ from the rest. No corrigendum is printed.

entries.title: TNERC Order No. 6 of 2025, TNPDCL tariff FY 2025-26
notes: Prints FY 2025-26 rates (schedule PDF pages 21-52). FY 2026-27 = those rates x (1 + April-on-April CPI change, capped at 6%) from 1 July 2026 (paras 3.1.1.13 p.23, 3.2.1(l) p.33-34); the CPI figure is not in the order.
